name: B10-0386/2026 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the evaluation of the Common Fisheries Policy and follow-up
part_text:
**What it asks for**

This is the European Parliament's opinion, not a new law. It responds to the European Commission's review of the common fisheries policy, the EU rules on fishing that date from 2013. The Parliament says the policy has not met its goals and that the world around it has changed a lot since then. It asks the Commission to come forward with concrete proposals to simplify the rules, cut paperwork, help the fishing fleet modernise and support small fishers and fish farmers.

**Key points**

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission for a clear plan and new laws by the end of 2026.
- **Who it affects:** Fishers, fish farmers, coastal communities, and seafood buyers and sellers across the EU.
- **What happens next:** If no proposals arrive by the end of 2026, Parliament may draft its own request for legislation.
